[LSIG.2.3.5] **Tumbling.** For `integral tumbling W`, at each bucket boundary
(deterministic epoch per [LSER.14.4.1]) the runtime closes the open interval
against the bucket end, snapshots `running_sum` as the completed-bucket
readable value, then resets: clears the ring, sets `running_sum = 0` and
`open_start = bucket_end`. `open_value` is not reset — the slot's current
value carries over as the initial hold for the new bucket. The in-progress
bucket is not queryable ([LSER.14.4.2]); queries return the most-recently
completed snapshot, and `0.0` before the first bucket closes.
